ModMetaData.description:
SexSlaveCraft 2.3.0 (TieJin Modify) 主奴同床、调教员身份与床位分配界面优化。 基于原模组 7 月停更时的 2.2.8 版本继续维护。 性奴可与绑定主人及有效指定调教员获得额外同床许可，实际共同睡眠后生成一天、不叠加的心情记忆。原版和 Dubs Mint Menus 分配界面显示独立身份标签及许可状态。 新增统一的调教员身份开关，并修复指定菜单红字、仪式拒绝原因及绑定角色身份切换导致锁链进度丢失的问题。包含 2.2.15 及更早版本修复。 旧 RimTalk 兼容继续暂停，宠物猫、宠物兔未完成入口继续禁用。 完整中英双语更新记录见模组目录中的 CHANGELOG.md。
Continues development from the upstream 2.2.8 baseline. Improves shared-bed permissions, trainer roles and bed assignment displays. Sex slaves may share with their bonded master and active assigned trainer, with non-stacking, one-day memories after actual shared sleep. Separate role badges and permission status support vanilla and Dubs Mint Menus. Fixes trainer-menu errors, misleading ritual rejection messages and loss of bond progress through identity changes. Includes fixes from 2.2.15 and earlier versions. Legacy RimTalk integration remains suspended. Unfinished Pet Cat and Pet Rabbit choices remain disabled. See CHANGELOG.md for the full Chinese and English release notes.
